title: Colorado PUC Decision C26-0016: Commission Decision Adopting Semi-Annual Virtual Audit Report 6
summary: Commission Decision Adopting Semi-Annual Virtual Audit Report 6
text:
Decision No. C26-0016 
BEFORE THE PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF COLORADO 
PROCEEDING NO. 23M-00217R 
REPOSITORY PROCEEDING FOR THREE-YEAR SAFETY OVERSIGHT AUDIT AND 
INVESTIGATIONS OF THE REGIONAL TRANSPORTATION DISTRICT. 
COMMISSION DECISION ADOPTING 
SEMI-ANNUAL VIRTUAL AUDIT REPORT 6 
Issued Date: 
January 9, 2026 
Adopted Date: January 7, 2026 

I. 
BY THE COMMISSION 
A. 
Statement 
1. 
This matter comes before the Commission for consideration of approval of the 
Semi-Annual Virtual and On-Site Safety Audit Report 6 (“Audit Report 6”) of the Metro Denver 
area Regional Transportation District (“RTD”) light rail operation filed on December 29, 2025. 
2. 
Audit Report 6 dated November 21, 2025, represents the sixth audit of a three-year 
on-site safety review of RTD’s Public Transportation Agency Safety Plan as required by 
Rule 7360 of the Rules Regulating Railroads, Rail Fixed Guideways, Transportation by Rail, and 
Rail Crossings, 5 Code of Colorado Regulations 723-7. Commission Safety Audit Rule 7360 was 
completed by Staff of the Commission (“Staff”). There are no findings made during the sixth audit 
of the cycle. 
3. 
As required by Rule 7360(c), RTD was provided 30 days to review the draft Audit 
Report 6. RTD’s comments were prepared and submitted to address the findings found during the 
Colorado PUC E-Filings System

Before the Public Utilities Commission of the State of Colorado 
Decision No. C26-0016 
PROCEEDING NO. 23M-00217R 
2 
audit. The Corrective Action Plans, if required, have been provided for the findings resulting from 
this audit. 
4. 
The Commission has reviewed Audit Report 6 prepared by Staff and concurs with 
the contents of the report. 
5. 
With the changes that will continuously be occurring to RTD’s Public 
Transportation Agency Safety Plan, RTD documentation, and potentially Commission Rules in 
the future, we will allow Staff the flexibility to update these checklists throughout the audit cycle 
as needed to make required reference changes and to change questions as RTD documentation is 
developed and updated. 
6. 
The Commission has jurisdiction in this matter under § 40-18-103, C.R.S., and Rule 
7360. 
II. 
ORDER 
A. 
The Commission Orders That: 
1. 
The Commission approves the Semi-Annual Virtual & On-Site Safety Audit 
Report 6 dated January 7, 2026. 
2. 
This Decision is effective immediately upon its Issued Date. 

Before the Public Utilities Commission of the State of Colorado
